skipReason: No build-vs-adopt decision exists in this phase. Every dependency it touches is already present, pinned, and exercised: the live harness boots a real server, the LLM stub needs no keys, serial_test is pinned at 4.0.1, and GitHub Actions already runs the compile gate. Verified 2026-08-09 — the matrix ran to completion in 194.70s and the live tier compiles in 1m54s. The phase's changes are: run an existing instrument, correct two of its assertions, wire an existing runner to an existing test, extend an existing case file, and add a shutdown hook to code we own. None is a library selection.

incumbents.name: serial_test
incumbents.evidence: Pinned in Cargo.toml. harness.rs:283-289 records a full run passing module-by-module while failing 7/16 concurrently on health-check timeouts, so serialisation is load-bearing rather than incidental.

incumbents.name: in-repo live harness
incumbents.role: boots a real server per case
incumbents.evidence: Exercised 2026-08-09: 20 cases, 194.70s, ~10s cold boot each. Was silently uncompilable for 25 days before repair, so it is now known-good rather than assumed-good.

incumbents.name: in-process OpenAI-compatible stub
incumbents.role: deterministic LLM backend for recorded mode
incumbents.evidence: No API keys, no token spend, no network. LIMIT: fixtures are authored by the test author, so a passing case against this stub is L2-wired, not L3-exercised, wherever correctness depends on model output.

incumbents.name: GitHub Actions
incumbents.role: CI runner for the blocking matrix gate (C-02)
incumbents.evidence: Already runs the live-tier compile gate. live-integration.yml:75 reads 'No continue-on-error. This is the gate.' C-02 adds execution alongside it, in a separate job — that file still carries two continue-on-error steps.
